title: Jonah and the Contact
author: Petra Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Galloway, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
